Name: Run Wiz MCP ADK Agent
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Launches a Google ADK Agent connected to the remote Wiz MCP server using Wiz MCP Integration service account credentials (Wiz Client ID, Wiz Client Secret, Wiz Data Center). The agent discovers and executes Wiz domain tools (issues, vulnerabilities, detections, inventory, identity, and more) to investigate cloud security context. Returns reasoning thoughts, executed tool calls, and final findings directly to the Case Wall and programmatic JSON outputs.

DynamicResults.ResultExample: {"thoughts": ["**Scoping the Wiz lookup**\n\nDiscover the issues domain, then query critical open issues for the resource."], "final_response": "Summary of findings...", "tool_calls": [{"tool": "discover", "args": {"domain": "issues"}}, {"tool": "execute", "args": {"tool_name": "<tool from discover>", "parameters": {"first": 10}}}], "code_logs": []}

Parameters.DefaultValue: Summarize the open critical Wiz issues in my environment.
Parameters.Description: The prompt or cloud security investigation instruction for the Wiz MCP-enabled agent.
Thinking budget (token count) for model reasoning (e.g. 1024).
Optional comma-separated list of Wiz MCP domains the agent should restrict itself to (e.g. 'issues, vulnerabilities, soc'). Leave empty to allow all domains.
Whether to equip the agent with persistent long-term memory via Vertex AI Memory Bank.
Optional session identifier to scope memory context. Defaults to active case ID (case_<CaseId>).
